topic: Flights move to Navi Mumbai airport
hook: IndiGo moves *12* daily Gulf flights to Navi Mumbai
tldr: IndiGo and Air India Group will shift many Mumbai flights, mostly West Asia, to Navi Mumbai from December.

beats.what: IndiGo shifts 12 daily international departures to NMIA; Air India Express starts 4 domestic flights there in December.
beats.why: Mumbai's main airport is rebuilding Terminal 1 by 2030 and needs space for new routes.
beats.care: Flying to the Gulf via Mumbai in 2027? Check whether your ticket says Navi Mumbai.

cards.body: IndiGo's routes moving include Bahrain, Riyadh, Dammam, Jeddah, Madinah, Kuwait, Muscat, Dhaka and Jakarta. It adds a daily Kathmandu flight from NMIA in 2027. Air India Express moves Oman flights from January 2027, then Jeddah, Riyadh, Doha, Sharjah and more by summer 2027.

cards.q: Two airports in one city: good or messy?
Why are flights moving out of Mumbai's main airport?
cards.why: CSMIA plans to redevelop Terminal 1 by 2030 (NewsBytes, Oct 25).

viz.l: daily IndiGo international flights moving to NMIA

learn.t: NMIA is Navi Mumbai International Airport, Mumbai's second airport. CSMIA is the main one in Santacruz.

watch: Exact shift dates per route, and road and metro links between the two airports.
